# Godrej Brooklyn Avenue Kukatpally

Canonical URL: https://godrejbrooklyn.info/

Godrej Brooklyn Avenue is a premium residential project page for Kukatpally, KPHB Colony, Hyderabad, Telangana 500085, India. Developed by Godrej Properties Limited, a subsidiary of the 127-year-old Godrej Group, listed on NSE and BSE.

Key project facts shown on the site:

- Project: Godrej Brooklyn Avenue Kukatpally
- Developer: Godrej Properties Limited (127+ year legacy, 30+ cities, 200M+ sq.ft developed, 300+ awards)
- RERA project registration number: P02200010981
- Location: 4th Phase Rd, KPHB Colony, Phase IV, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500085
- Configurations: 3 BHK and 4 BHK residences
- Listed sizes: 1,810 to 1,899 sq.ft (3 BHK Premium), 2,200 sq.ft (3 BHK Luxe), 3,200 sq.ft (4 BHK Luxury)
- Community scale: 7.76 acres
- Tower height: G+46 floors (tallest in Kukatpally)
- Open space: 75% open green spaces
- Clubhouse: 72,000 sq.ft multi-level facility (G+7 floors)
- Architecture: New York-inspired Brooklyn-style design
- EOI amounts shown: Rs. 10 Lakhs for 3 BHK under 2000 sq.ft, Rs. 15 Lakhs for 3 BHK over 2000 sq.ft, and Rs. 20 Lakhs for 4 BHK luxury residences
- Payment plan: Construction-linked payment plan
- Current unit price: request the latest price breakup through the page form, phone, or WhatsApp
- Current phase: Pre-launch EOI phase
- Home loan partners: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis Bank
